items.title: 18.8 Complexes ka istehkaam aur stability constant (Kstab) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of stability constants (PDF 30-31).

blocks.text: Stability constant, Kstab, kisi solvent mein complex ion ke apne ajza (ions ya molecules) se banne ka equilibrium constant hai. Paani mein paani pehla ligand hai; naya ligand dhaat ke ion ke liye us se muqabla karta hai. Maslan:

Paani, yani solvent, ka concentration amalan qaim rehta hai aur Kstab ke expression se nikal diya jata hai. Stability constants aam taur par log10 Kstab ki shakal mein diye jate hain, jis se bohat bare adad ka muqabla aasan hota hai. log10 Kstab jitna zyada, complex utna mustahkam aur equilibrium utna daen; jitna kam, complex utna kam mustahkam aur us ke ligands utni aasani se hat'te hain.

blocks.caption: Kuch copper(II) complexes ke stability constants (kitab ka Table 18.5)

blocks.text: Polydentate ligands ke complexes ke stability constants monodentate ligands ke complexes se zyada hote hain; yeh chelate effect hai, maslan [Cu(H2O)6]2+ + 3en -> [Cu(en)3]2+ + 6H2O. Zyada Kstab dene wala ligand kam Kstab wale ko hata sakta hai: peele chloride complex mein ammonia milane se mehlool gehra neela ho jata hai, kyunke ammonia complex kaheen zyada mustahkam hai: [CuCl4]2- + 4NH3 + 2H2O -> [Cu(NH3)4(H2O)2]2+ + 4Cl-. Ulta, complex ko bohat zyada paani se patla karne par equilibrium baen taraf wapas ja sakta aur hydrated ion dobara banta hai.

blocks.title: Table 18.5 mein ammonia complex
blocks.text: Kitab is complex ko [Cu(NH3)6]2- aur hataane ka mua'adla 6NH3 ke saath chhaapti hai. Topic 18.7.1 mein bayan copper(II) ka ammonia complex [Cu(NH3)4(H2O)2]2+ hai, aik musbat ion, aur sabaq yahi formula use karta hai.

blocks.prompt: [Cu(H2O)6]2+ aur NH3 se [Cu(NH3)4]2+ banne ka Kstab expression likhein.
blocks.explanation: [Cu(H2O)6]2+ + 4NH3 <=> [Cu(NH3)4(H2O)2]2+ + 4H2O ke liye: Kstab = [Cu(NH3)4(H2O)2 2+] / ([Cu(H2O)6 2+] [NH3]^4); paani shamil nahi.

blocks.prompt: [CuCl4]2- (5.6) aur [Cu(EDTA)]2- (18.8) ke log10 Kstab se samjhayein ke polydentate ligands zyada mustahkam complexes kyun banate hain.
blocks.explanation: EDTA complex taqreeban 10^13 guna zyada mustahkam hai. Aik EDTA ion chhe donor atoms se dhaat ko halqon (rings) mein pakarta aur chhe paani ke molecules ki jagah leta hai, is liye azad zarron ki tadaad barhti hai; yeh chelate effect complex ke haq mein hai.

blocks.prompt: [Cu(H2O)6]2+ mein paani ki jagah ammonia ke qadam ba qadam aane ke pehle qadam ka mua'adla likhein.

items: Kstab = complex banne ka equilibrium constant; paani shamil nahi.
Zyada log10 Kstab = zyada mustahkam; chelate effect EDTA (18.8) aur en complexes ko bohat mustahkam banata.
Zyada Kstab wala ligand kam wale ko hatata; patla karna ulat sakta.
